text.tspan: Designed three separate stages: differential amplifier, buffer, and output stage.
Determined circuit parameters with hand calculations to meet design requirements.
Built each stage on the breadboard and validated separately with an oscilloscope and spectrum
Combined the stages and measured open
Tested the circuit in a closed
Potentiometers were placed in R8, R13, and R16 for tuning.
